blurb.en: One, two and three arguments, a negative step, an empty range - and a range of half a million numbers that takes up almost no room.
blurb.zh: 一个、两个、三个参数，负步长，空的 range——还有一个装着五十万个数、却几乎不占地方的 range。

en: range(stop) counts from 0; range(start, stop) counts from start; range(start, stop, step) jumps by step each time. In every shape the stop value itself is never included. That is why range(5) gives the five numbers 0 to 4, and why, with a step of 1, the number of values is simply stop minus start.

A negative step counts down, and then the start has to be bigger than the stop: range(10, 0, -3) gives 10, 7, 4 and 1, and stops before it reaches 0. Get the direction wrong - range(5, 0), where the step is the default +1 - and there is no error, just an empty range, so a loop over it quietly does nothing. The one thing range refuses outright is a step of 0, which raises ValueError.

A range is not a list. It stores only its start, stop and step and works everything else out when asked: len(), indexing with square brackets and the in test are all answered by arithmetic, without producing the numbers. That is why a range up to a million is instant, and why printing a range shows the range itself rather than its numbers. list(r) is what really builds the numbers - show uses it so that you can see them.
countdown prints its numbers on one line because print is given end=" ": instead of ending each number with a newline it ends it with a space, and the print after the loop finishes the line.
zh: range(stop) 从 0 数起；range(start, stop) 从 start 数起；range(start, stop, step) 每次跳 step。无论哪种写法，终点 stop 本身都取不到。所以 range(5) 给出 0 到 4 这五个数；步长为 1 时，值的个数就是 stop 减 start。
负步长就是倒着数，这时起点必须比终点大：range(10, 0, -3) 给出 10、7、4、1，到 0 之前停下。方向弄反——比如 range(5, 0)，步长是默认的 +1——不会报错，只是得到一个空的 range，对它循环就悄无声息地什么也不做。range 唯一当场拒绝的是步长 0，会抛 ValueError。
range 不是列表。它只存起点、终点、步长，别的都在被问到时现算：len()、方括号取下标、in 测试，全靠算术回答，不必把数一个个造出来。所以一个到一百万的 range 瞬间就建好了，打印一个 range 显示的也是 range 本身而不是里面的数。真正把数造出来的是 list(r)——show 用它，好让你看见这些数。
countdown 把数印在同一行，是因为 print 带了 end=" "：每个数后面接的不是换行而是一个空格，循环之后的那个 print 再把这一行收尾。

lineNotes.en: Printing a range shows it in its range(start, stop) form - even range(5) is shown with its hidden start of 0.
lineNotes.zh: 打印一个 range 显示的是 range(start, stop) 这种形式——连 range(5) 也会把隐含的起点 0 写出来。

lineNotes.en: Start 5, stop 0, step +1: counting up from 5 never gets down to 0, so this range is empty.
lineNotes.zh: 起点 5、终点 0、步长 +1：从 5 往上数永远到不了 0，所以这个 range 是空的。

lineNotes.en: len, indexing and in on a range are all worked out by arithmetic - no list of 500000 numbers is ever built.
lineNotes.zh: 对 range 求 len、取下标、做 in 测试，全靠算术——从头到尾没有造出一个装 500000 个数的列表。

blurb.en: Read whole numbers one line at a time until the word done, keeping a running total and a count, then work out the mean.
blurb.zh: 一行读一个整数，读到 done 为止，边读边累加、边计数，最后求均值。

en: A sentinel is a special value that is not data but a signal to stop - here, the word done. A for loop does not fit, because nobody knows in advance how many numbers will be typed; a while loop that keeps going until the sentinel turns up is the natural shape.

The input is read in two places: once before the loop, and again as the very last line of the loop body. The first read gives the while test something to look at the first time round; the second gives it something new every time after that. Forget the second one and text never changes, so the loop adds the first number for ever. Testing before adding also means the word done itself is never handed to int(), which would raise ValueError.

Two accumulators run side by side: total starts at 0 and has each number added to it, count starts at 0 and goes up by one each time. The mean is total / count, but only when count is above 0: if done is the very first thing typed, dividing by zero would raise ZeroDivisionError, so the demo block checks first. / always gives a float, even when the mean comes out whole.

The demo feeds five lines through standard input: 12, 7, 20, 5 and done. input() does not echo what it reads, so in the captured output the five prompts run together on one line, followed by the result. Run it in PyCharm and type the same five lines yourself: each answer then appears after its prompt.
zh: 哨兵是一个特殊的值：它不是数据，而是「停」的信号——这里是单词 done。for 循环不合适，因为事先谁也不知道会输入多少个数；一个一直转到哨兵出现为止的 while 循环才是自然的样子。
输入在两处读：循环之前读一次，循环体的最后一行再读一次。第一次让 while 的条件在头一回有东西可看；第二次让它此后每一轮都看到新的内容。忘了第二次，text 就永远不变，循环会没完没了地加第一个数。先判断再相加，还保证了 done 这个词本身永远不会交给 int()——否则会抛 ValueError。
两个累加器并排跑：total 从 0 开始、每个数都加进去；count 从 0 开始、每次加一。均值是 total / count，但只能在 count 大于 0 时算：如果头一个输入就是 done，除以零会抛 ZeroDivisionError，所以演示块先查一下。/ 的结果总是浮点数，即使均值恰好是整数。
演示通过标准输入喂了五行：12、7、20、5 和 done。input() 不回显读到的内容，所以在捕获到的输出里，五个提示语连成一行，后面紧跟结果。在 PyCharm 里运行、自己敲这五行时，每个答案会出现在它的提示语后面。

lineNotes.en: The first read happens before the loop, so that the while test has something to check the very first time.
lineNotes.zh: 第一次读在循环之前，好让 while 的条件在头一回就有东西可查。

lineNotes.en: The second accumulator: it counts the numbers, not their values.
lineNotes.zh: 第二个累加器：它数的是有几个数，不是数的大小。

lineNotes.en: Guards against dividing by zero when no numbers were entered at all.
lineNotes.zh: 一个数都没输入时，挡住除以零。

run.expect:
Number (or done): Number (or done): Number (or done): Number (or done): Number (or done): 4 numbers, total 44
mean 11.0

title.en: Skip with continue, Stop with break

blurb.en: Read a small robot script line by line: blank lines and comments are skipped, and END stops the reading even though more lines follow.
blurb.zh: 逐行读一段小机器人脚本：空行和注释跳过，读到 END 就停下——哪怕后面还有行。

en: continue and break both cut a pass of the loop short, in different ways. continue abandons only the current pass: the rest of the body is skipped and the loop carries on with the next line. break abandons the whole loop: no more lines are looked at, and the program goes on after the loop. Here continue handles the lines that should be ignored, and break the line that says there is nothing more to read.

The order of the steps matters. The line is tidied first, so that a comment with spaces in front of it still starts with # once the spaces are gone. The skip test comes before the END test, and both come before the append, so neither a comment nor END itself ever reaches the list of commands.

Without continue, everything after the skip test would have to sit inside an else, pushing the real work one level deeper. Dealing with the uninteresting cases early and keeping the main work unindented is the same idea as a guard clause at the top of a function.
forward 99 is never read: the loop stopped at END. break leaves only the innermost loop it is in; with one loop inside another, the outer loop would carry on.
zh: continue 与 break 都会让这一轮提前结束，但方式不同。continue 只放弃当前这一轮：循环体剩下的部分跳过，循环接着处理下一行。break 放弃整个循环：后面的行一行都不再看，程序从循环之后继续。这里 continue 处理该忽略的行，break 处理那一行「后面没什么可读了」。
步骤的顺序有讲究。先整理这一行，这样前面带空格的注释去掉空格之后照样以 # 开头。跳过的判断在 END 的判断之前，两者又都在 append 之前，所以注释和 END 本身都进不了命令列表。
没有 continue，跳过判断之后的所有语句都得塞进一个 else 里，真正干活的部分就要再缩进一层。先把无关的情况打发掉、让主要工作保持不缩进，和函数开头的守卫子句是同一个思路。
forward 99 从没被读到：循环在 END 处就停了。break 只离开它所在的最内层循环；如果是循环套循环，外层循环会继续。

lineNotes.en: Once the line has been stripped, a blank line is the empty string, so it and a comment are caught by the same test.
lineNotes.zh: 去掉两端空白之后，空行就是空字符串，所以它和注释用同一个判断就能接住。

lineNotes.en: Only reached by lines that were neither skipped nor the end marker.
lineNotes.zh: 只有既没被跳过、也不是结束标记的行才会走到这里。

lineNotes.en: Spaces in front of the #: without the tidy-up line this would not start with # and would be kept as a command.
lineNotes.zh: # 前面有空格：没有整理那一行的话，它不以 # 开头，会被当成命令留下。

blurb.en: Walk the list once, remembering the largest value so far and where it was - starting from the first element, not from 0.
blurb.zh: 把列表走一遍，记住目前最大的值和它在哪——从第一个元素起步，而不是从 0。

en: The largest-so-far pattern needs a starting value, and 0 looks tempting. It is wrong: in a list of negative numbers every element is smaller than 0, so nothing ever replaces it, and the function would report a largest value of 0 - a value that is not even in the list. The first element is always a safe start, because it is a real value from the list.
Because the first element is already the starting value, the loop begins at index 1. The position is wanted as well as the value, so the loop runs over positions and reads each element by its index.

The comparison is strict, and that decides which position is reported when the largest value appears more than once. In [3, 9, 2, 9, 4] the second 9 is not bigger than the first, so nothing changes and the reported position stays with the first 9. Allow equality and the later 9 would win instead.

An empty list has no first element, so looking it up raises IndexError. That is fair - an empty list has no largest value - but whoever calls the function has to know. Python's own max() refuses an empty list too, with ValueError.
return best, best_index hands back a tuple of two values, and a printed tuple appears in round brackets.
zh: 「目前最大」这个模式需要一个初值，0 看起来很顺手。但它是错的：列表里全是负数时，每个元素都比 0 小，谁也换不掉它，函数会报告最大值是 0——一个根本不在列表里的值。第一个元素永远是安全的起点，因为它确实是列表里的一个值。
既然第一个元素已经当了初值，循环就从下标 1 开始。除了值还要位置，所以循环走的是下标，每个元素按下标取出来。
比较是严格的，这决定了最大值出现不止一次时报告哪个位置。在 [3, 9, 2, 9, 4] 里，第二个 9 并不比第一个大，所以什么都不变，报告的位置留在第一个 9 上。要是相等也算，赢的就会是后面那个 9。
空列表没有第一个元素，取它会抛 IndexError。这说得过去——空列表本来就没有最大值——但调用函数的人得心里有数。Python 自己的 max() 同样拒绝空列表，抛的是 ValueError。
return best, best_index 交回的是一个装两个值的元组，打印出来带圆括号。

lineNotes.en: The position that goes with the starting value.
lineNotes.zh: 与初值配套的位置。

lineNotes.en: Value and position are always updated together, so they can never describe two different elements.
lineNotes.zh: 值和位置总是一起更新，所以它们不可能说的是两个不同的元素。

blurb.en: A Boolean flag starts out as not found, is switched the moment a negative number turns up, and is the answer once the loop is over.
blurb.zh: 一个布尔标志从「没找到」开始，一碰到负数就改过来，循环结束后它就是答案。

en: A flag is a variable that remembers whether something has happened. It is given its has-not-happened value before the loop, switched inside the loop when the thing happens, and read after the loop. Nothing in the loop ever switches it back, so once a negative number has been seen, the answer stays yes.

break is not needed for the answer to be right: without it the loop would look at every remaining element and the flag would simply stay True. It is there because once one negative number has been found the question is settled, and looking further is wasted work.

An empty list never enters the loop, so the flag keeps its starting value and the answer is False - which is correct, because an empty list contains no negative numbers. Choosing the starting value is choosing the answer for the case where nothing is found.
has-negative-for-else answers the same question without setting up a flag before the loop. Put the two side by side to see exactly which line moves.
zh: 标志位是一个记住「某件事发生过没有」的变量。循环之前给它「没发生」的值，循环里一旦那件事发生就把它改过来，循环之后再读它。循环里没有任何地方会把它改回去，所以只要见过一个负数，答案就一直是「有」。
答案对不对并不靠 break：没有它，循环会把剩下的元素都看一遍，标志照样保持 True。加上它，是因为找到一个负数问题就已经有了答案，再往下看是白费功夫。
空列表根本进不了循环，标志保持初值，答案是 False——这是对的，空列表里确实没有负数。选初值，就是在选「什么都没找到」时的答案。
has-negative-for-else 回答同一个问题，但不在循环前立标志。把两个并排放，就能看清到底挪动了哪一行。

lineNotes.en: Strictly less than 0 - 0 itself is not negative, which is why [4, 0, 7] gives False.
lineNotes.zh: 严格小于 0——0 本身不是负数，所以 [4, 0, 7] 得到 False。

lineNotes.en: The flag is read after the loop: by now it holds the answer.
lineNotes.zh: 循环结束后读标志：此时它就是答案。

blurb.en: The same question answered with a loop's else branch, which runs only when the loop was never stopped by break.
blurb.zh: 同一个问题，用循环的 else 分支来回答：只有循环没被 break 打断时，它才执行。

en: A for loop can have an else branch, and it is easy to misread. It does not mean the loop did not run; it means the loop finished without break. When break runs, the else branch is skipped. When the loop reaches the end of the list - including an empty list, where it ends at once - the else branch runs.

That is exactly the not-found case of a search, so the language does the flag's job. Put this beside has-negative-flag: the only difference is that setting found to False has moved from before the loop into the else branch, so it now happens only when nothing was found.

The else lines up with for, not with the if inside the loop. Indent it one level further and it becomes the if's else instead: it then runs for every element that is not negative, and an empty list crashes with UnboundLocalError, because found is never given a value.

Inside a function there is an even shorter way: return True from inside the loop and return False after it, with neither a flag nor else. for...else earns its place when what follows the search is not a return - printing a message only when nothing was found, for example.
zh: for 循环可以带一个 else 分支，而且很容易读错。它的意思不是「循环没有执行」，而是「循环没被 break 打断、自己走完了」。break 一执行，else 分支就被跳过；循环走到列表末尾——包括空列表，一开始就到了末尾——else 分支就执行。
这正好就是查找里「没找到」的情形，于是标志位的活由语言替你干了。和 has-negative-flag 并排对照：唯一的区别是把 found 设为 False 这件事从循环之前挪进了 else 分支，现在只有什么都没找到时才发生。
else 与 for 对齐，不与循环里的 if 对齐。再多缩进一层，它就变成了 if 的 else：每遇到一个非负元素都会执行一次，而空列表会崩在 UnboundLocalError 上，因为 found 从没被赋过值。
在函数里还有更短的写法：循环里直接 return True，循环后 return False，既不要标志也不要 else。for…else 真正派上用场，是在查找之后要做的事不是 return 的时候——比如只在什么都没找到时打印一句话。

lineNotes.en: break skips the else branch below as well as the rest of the loop.
lineNotes.zh: break 不仅跳过循环剩下的部分，也跳过下面的 else 分支。

lineNotes.en: By now either the loop body or the else branch has given found a value.
lineNotes.zh: 走到这里时，found 要么由循环体、要么由 else 分支赋过值了。

blurb.en: Peel the digits off a number from the right with remainder and floor division, adding each one up, without ever turning the number into text.
blurb.zh: 用取余和整除从右边一位一位剥下数位、逐个加起来，全程不把数变成文字。

en: n % 10 is the remainder when n is divided by 10, which is its last digit: 472 % 10 is 2. n // 10 is floor division, which throws the last digit away: 472 // 10 is 47. Doing both, again and again, takes the digits off one at a time from the right - 2, then 7, then 4 - until nothing is left.

The two lines in the loop body must come in that order. Remove the digit first and the digit you add is already the next one along: the last digit is skipped, and a 0 is added at the end in its place.

The loop stops when n reaches 0, and for n = 0 it does not run at all, giving a sum of 0, which is right. The n inside digit_sum is the function's own name for the value: making it smaller does not change the n in the demo loop, which is why each line prints the original number beside its digit sum.

This works only for whole numbers that are not negative: for a negative n the loop never starts and the sum comes out as 0. The same two operations with 2 in place of 10 would take the bits off a number instead of its decimal digits.
zh: n % 10 是 n 除以 10 的余数，也就是它的最后一位：472 % 10 是 2。n // 10 是整除，把最后一位扔掉：472 // 10 是 47。两件事反复做，就从右边一位一位地剥下数位——先 2，再 7，再 4——直到什么都不剩。
循环体里那两行的顺序不能反。先去掉这一位，加进去的就已经是下一位了：最后一位被漏掉，末尾反而多加了一个 0。
n 变成 0 时循环停下；n = 0 时循环一次都不转，和是 0，这是对的。digit_sum 里的 n 是函数自己给这个值起的名字：把它变小不会改动演示循环里的 n，所以每一行打印出来的仍是原来的数和它的数位和。
这个办法只适用于非负整数：n 是负数时循环根本不会开始，和算出来是 0。把两处的 10 换成 2，同样的两步剥下的就是二进制位，而不是十进制数位。

lineNotes.en: The accumulator: no digits have been added yet.
lineNotes.zh: 累加器：还一位都没加。

lineNotes.en: This n belongs to the demo loop; the function's n shrinking to 0 does not touch it.
lineNotes.zh: 这个 n 属于演示循环；函数里的 n 缩到 0 碰不到它。

title.en: Digit Sum: by Way of a String

blurb.en: Turn the number into text, walk along its characters, and turn each one back into a number to add it up.
blurb.zh: 把数变成文字，逐个走过它的字符，再把每个字符变回数加起来。

en: Converting 472 to a string gives the text "472", and a for loop over a string hands out its characters one at a time: "4", "7", "2". Each is a digit written as text, so it has to become a number before it can be added. Adding a string to the int total would raise TypeError.

This reads more directly than the % 10 version, and it takes the digits from left to right rather than right to left - for a sum the order makes no difference. The cost is building a string first, which for everyday numbers does not matter at all.

Put it beside digit-sum-modulo and try a negative number in your head. Here the minus sign becomes a character "-", and int("-") raises ValueError; the % 10 version quietly returns 0 instead. Neither is right for negative numbers - they just go wrong in different ways.
zh: 把 472 转成字符串得到文字 "472"，对字符串做 for 循环会一次给出一个字符："4"、"7"、"2"。每个都是写成文字的数字，得先变成数才能相加。把字符串加到整数 total 上会抛 TypeError。
这比 % 10 的写法读起来更直接，而且是从左往右取数位，不是从右往左——求和的话顺序无所谓。代价是先要造一个字符串，对日常大小的数来说完全不值一提。
和 digit-sum-modulo 并排，心里拿一个负数试试。这里负号会变成字符 "-"，int("-") 抛 ValueError；% 10 的版本则悄悄交回 0。两者对负数都不对——只是错的方式不一样。

lineNotes.en: Every character has been turned into a number and added by now.
lineNotes.zh: 到这里，每个字符都已经变成数加进去了。

blurb.en: Two loops, one inside the other, try every pair of different positions until two numbers add up to the target.
blurb.zh: 两层循环一层套一层，把不同位置上的每一对都试一遍，直到有两个数加起来等于目标。

en: The outer loop picks the first number of the pair by its position i. The inner loop picks the second by its position j, and only looks at positions after i. That one choice does two jobs: a number is never paired with itself, so a single 4 cannot make a target of 8 on its own, and every pair is tried once rather than twice.

return True inside the inner loop leaves both loops and the function at once - the simplest way to stop nested loops early, since break would leave only the inner one. return False sits after both loops, lined up with the outer for, so it is reached only when every pair has been tried.

How much work is that? A list of n numbers has n(n-1)/2 pairs: 10 for five numbers, about 5000 for a hundred, about 500000 for a thousand. Doubling the length of the list roughly quadruples the work, which is what O(n^2) means. In exchange it needs nothing from the list - it does not have to be sorted.
pair-sum-two-pointers answers the same question with a single pass over a sorted list.
zh: 外层循环按位置 i 选出这一对里的第一个数；里层循环按位置 j 选出第二个，而且只看 i 之后的位置。这一个选择同时办了两件事：一个数永远不会和它自己配对，所以单独一个 4 凑不出目标 8；每一对也只试一次，而不是两次。
里层循环里的 return True 一步就离开了两层循环和整个函数——这是提前结束嵌套循环最简单的办法，因为 break 只能离开里层那一个。return False 放在两层循环之后、与外层的 for 对齐，所以只有每一对都试过了才走到它。
工作量有多大？n 个数有 n(n-1)/2 对：五个数 10 对，一百个数约 5000 对，一千个数约 500000 对。列表长度翻倍，工作量大约变成四倍，这就是 O(n^2) 的意思。作为交换，它对列表毫无要求——不必排好序。
pair-sum-two-pointers 在排好序的列表上只走一遍，回答同一个问题。

lineNotes.en: Worked out once and used by both loops.
lineNotes.zh: 只算一次，两层循环都用它。

lineNotes.en: Leaves both loops and the function in one step.
lineNotes.zh: 一步离开两层循环和整个函数。

blurb.en: On a sorted list, one pointer at each end walks inwards, and every comparison rules out a whole row of pairs.
blurb.zh: 在排好序的列表上，两端各放一个指针往中间走，每比较一次就排除一整排组合。

en: left starts at the smallest number and right at the largest. Look at their sum. If it is exactly the target, the answer is yes. If it is too small, the only way to make it bigger is to swap the left number for the next one up, so left moves one place right. If it is too big, right moves one place left. Either way, one position is ruled out for good.

Why ruling a position out is safe: if the smallest number still in play plus the largest one still in play is too small, the smallest cannot reach the target with any partner, because every other partner is smaller than the largest. Nothing is lost by moving past it. The same argument turned round covers moving right inwards when the sum is too big.

The pointers stop when they meet, because two pointers on the same place are one number, and a number cannot pair with itself. Every pass moves one pointer one place, so there are at most n - 1 passes: O(n) work, against the n(n-1)/2 pairs of pair-sum-nested-loops. For a thousand numbers that is fewer than a thousand steps instead of about half a million.
The price is a precondition: the list must already be sorted from smallest to largest. On an unsorted list the argument above falls apart and the function can miss a pair that is really there.
zh: left 从最小的数出发，right 从最大的数出发。看它们的和：正好等于目标，答案就是「有」。太小，要让和变大只能把左边那个数换成下一个更大的，于是 left 右移一格。太大，right 左移一格。无论哪种，都有一个位置被彻底排除。
为什么排除是安全的：如果还在考虑范围里的最小数加上最大数仍然太小，那最小的这个数跟谁配都够不着目标——别的搭档都比最大的那个小。跳过它什么也不会漏掉。和太大时把 right 往里挪，是同一个道理反过来说。
两个指针碰头时停下，因为指在同一格上的只是一个数，一个数不能和自己配对。每一轮挪动一个指针一格，所以最多 n - 1 轮：O(n) 的工作量，对比 pair-sum-nested-loops 的 n(n-1)/2 对。一千个数时，是不到一千步对约五十万步。
代价是一个前提条件：列表必须已经从小到大排好序。在没排序的列表上，上面的推理就站不住了，函数可能漏掉一对确实存在的数。

lineNotes.en: The smallest and the largest numbers still in play.
lineNotes.zh: 还在考虑范围里的最小数与最大数。

lineNotes.en: Too big: the only way down is to swap the right number for the next smaller one.
lineNotes.zh: 太大了：要变小，只能把右边的数换成下一个更小的。

title.en: Guess the Number in Limited Tries

blurb.en: A while loop with a limit on tries: break when the guess is right, and a while...else branch for when the tries run out.
blurb.zh: 带次数上限的 while 循环：猜中就 break，次数用完就走 while…else 那一支。

en: The loop has two ways to end, and the program needs to know which one happened. Either the guess was right and break left the loop, or the test became false because every try had been used. A while loop's else branch runs only in the second case, so the out-of-tries message needs no extra flag.

tries goes up by one straight after each guess is read, before anything is compared. That way it already counts the current guess: the message after a correct guess shows the right number, and the while test sees the updated count when it decides whether another try is allowed.
The loop's else lines up with while. Indented one level further, Python would read it as a second else for the if just above it and reject the whole program with a SyntaxError.

The secret numbers are written into the demo block rather than chosen at random, so that the output is the same on every run and can be checked. A real game would pick the secret with the random module.

The demo plays two games through standard input: 50, 25, 40 and 37 against the secret 37 with five tries, found on the fourth; then 50, 25 and 6 against the secret 12 with only three tries. input() does not echo what it reads, so in the captured output each prompt is followed directly by the reply to it. In PyCharm, type those seven guesses yourself.
zh: 这个循环有两种结束方式，程序得知道是哪一种。要么猜中了、break 离开循环；要么次数全用完、条件变成假。while 循环的 else 分支只在第二种情况执行，所以「次数用完」那句话不需要额外的标志位。
每读完一个猜测，tries 立刻加一，在任何比较之前。这样它已经把当前这次算进去了：猜中后的那句话显示的次数是对的，while 的条件判断还能不能再猜时，看到的也是更新后的次数。
循环的 else 与 while 对齐。再多缩进一层，Python 会把它当成紧挨在上面那个 if 的第二个 else，整个程序以 SyntaxError 被拒绝。
秘密数直接写在演示块里，而不是随机挑选，这样每次运行输出都一样，才能核对。真正的游戏会用 random 模块来挑秘密数。
演示通过标准输入玩了两局：第一局秘密数 37、五次机会，依次猜 50、25、40、37，第四次猜中；第二局秘密数 12、只有三次机会，猜 50、25、6。input() 不回显读到的内容，所以在捕获到的输出里，每个提示语后面紧跟对它的回应。在 PyCharm 里运行时，自己依次敲这七个猜测。

lineNotes.en: int() raises ValueError if the reply is not a whole number; handling that is what input-validation-loop in py-files-errors is about.
lineNotes.zh: 回复不是整数时 int() 会抛 ValueError；怎么处理，见 py-files-errors 里的 input-validation-loop。

lineNotes.en: Counted straight after reading, so this guess is already included.
lineNotes.zh: 读完立刻计数，这一次已经算在里面了。

blurb.en: Fizz for multiples of 3, Buzz for multiples of 5, FizzBuzz for both - and the order of the tests is the whole trick.
blurb.zh: 3 的倍数说 Fizz，5 的倍数说 Buzz，两者都是就说 FizzBuzz——判断的顺序就是全部诀窍。

en: An if/elif chain stops at the first test that is true. For 15, the tests for 3, for 5 and for both are all true - so whichever comes first wins. Put the test for 3 first and 15 comes out as Fizz, because the test for both is never reached. The most specific case has to be checked before the general cases that it is part of.
A number that is a multiple of both 3 and 5 is a multiple of 15, because 3 and 5 have no common factor. So a single remainder test covers both conditions at once.

Every branch hands back a string, the plain number included. Returning the int itself would print the same, but a function whose result is sometimes a str and sometimes an int is a trap for whoever uses it next: joining the results with ", ".join(), for example, would fail on the ints.
zh: if/elif 链停在第一个为真的判断上。对 15 来说，「是 3 的倍数」「是 5 的倍数」「两者都是」全都为真——谁排在前面谁赢。把判 3 的放在最前，15 就输出 Fizz，因为「两者都是」那个判断根本轮不到。最具体的情形，必须排在包含它的那些一般情形之前判断。
既是 3 的倍数又是 5 的倍数的数，就是 15 的倍数，因为 3 和 5 没有公因数。所以一次取余判断就同时覆盖了两个条件。
每一支交回的都是字符串，普通数字那一支也不例外。直接交回整数打印出来一样，但一个结果有时是 str、有时是 int 的函数，是给下一个用它的人埋的坑：比如用 ", ".join() 把结果连起来，遇到整数就会失败。

lineNotes.en: Only reached when n is not a multiple of 15, so a multiple of 3 that gets here is not also a multiple of 5.
lineNotes.zh: 只有 n 不是 15 的倍数时才走到这里，所以到这儿的 3 的倍数一定不是 5 的倍数。

lineNotes.en: The loop only prints; every decision lives in the function, which is what lets the function be tested on its own.
lineNotes.zh: 循环只管打印；所有判断都在函数里，所以函数可以单独拿出来测试。
